batches.body:
Ten reviewed, green PRs had piled up behind master's CI, and each merge made the rest re-run an hour-long Rust workflow. GitHub's merge queue is not available on this repository, so this branch lands them together under one CI run instead: it is master plus each PR merged unchanged, with no conflicts.

## What is in it

| PR | Change | Lane |
|---|---|---|
| #833 | Rust: serve `memory_consolidation_candidates` over MCP (task K) | Rust |
| #835 | Parity harness: stop Windows losing a chunked body-limit refusal (fixes #830) | Rust |
| #845 | Rust shim: deflake the registered-note retry test | Rust |
| #849 | Rust shim: a slow disk no longer freezes tool calls while board state saves | Rust |
| #840 | CI: opt-in self-hosted lane for comparing parity shards | Rust workflow |
| #834 | Docs: why the three Dependabot alerts have no usable fix | docs + lock comment |
| #837 | Tests: stop the recall expansion-loop budget test failing on a slow runner | test-only |
| #838 | Python shim: a board call survives one dropped identity check | Python |
| #846 | Tests: run the WSL full suite on 4 workers without stalling on Postgres checkpoints | test infra |
| #848 | Plugin hooks: a short Stop-hook wait still looks for mail | plugin |

Each PR keeps its own description, reviews and evidence; this PR adds no code of its own. Base: master `4d329066`. Each PR head was merged with `--no-ff` in the order above; `git show --remerge-diff` lists no file for any of the ten merges, and no file is touched by more than one PR (54 files, 54 distinct).

## Gate, per constituent PR (checked 2026-10-19)

- Opus reviewer and Codex second review (`gpt-6.1-sol`, high) recorded in each PR.
- Private publication check: clean on each PR's commit range and PR text, and on this branch's range.
- No promotional footer; every commit authored by the noreply address.
- Green CI on each PR's own head.
- Local full suite: required only for #846 (shared test infrastructure, `tests/pg_fixtures.py`), which records it passed at its head `7383b0d2` (local WSL, 4 workers). The others state "not required under the ordinary-code rule".

## Local validation on this branch (head `731c6ba8`)

- Every test file any of the ten PRs added or changed, plus the doc guards and `tests/test_changelog_fragments.py`: 7,073 passed, 39 skipped (Windows host, bench Postgres up). Every skip is a POSIX-only or Linux-only test (`/proc`, `setsid`, POSIX file modes and ownership, `kill -0`); none is a database skip. Linux CI runs them.
- The Rust and eval harness tests the PRs touched (`rust/ci/test_workflow.py`, `rust/daemon/harness/test_body_cases.py`, `test_mcp_ci.py`, `test_mcp_mutant_verdict.py`, `test_mcp_runner.py`), in an environment pinned to `mcp==2.2.0` / `mcp-types==2.2.0` / `pydantic==2.14.0` / `pydantic-core==2.50.0`: 418 passed.
- Local full suite: not required, clean integration batch.

## Reviews of the batch

The batch adds no code, so its review looks only for defects that come from combining the ten: an Opus reviewer subagent and a Codex second review (`gpt-6.1-sol`, high) over `origin/master...HEAD`. Their results are added below when they finish.

## After merge

This PR is squash-merged; the ten PRs are then closed as merged via this batch, with a comment on each. #838 and #848 change client-side code (the Python shim, the plugin's Stop hook): clients pick them up with `pseudolife-mcp update --all` or `python ops/update_clients.py`.
